question: To which country did India offer extensive security cooperation, especially after Operation Cactus in 1988?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Operation Cactus’ was the operation by Indian Armed forces to foil the coup in Maldives.
 
• The operation commenced in November 1988.
 
• Operation Cactus was carried out by India in order to curb the terrorist attack from the Government of Maldives.
 
• US President called this operation "an immense contribution to regional security."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India to the Maldives**

 
 
• **India and Maldives share deep cultural, ethnic, religious, and people-to-people ties.**
 
• India was **among the first nations that recognized and establish diplomatic relations with the Maldives in 1972 after independence in 1965.**
 
• India has always helped the Maldives under challenging situations, as explained in the following points:
 
• **1986:** India agreed to establish Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital (IGMH) in Male. This hospital is a very advanced tertiary care hospital in the Maldives.
 
• **1988**: India launched Operation Cactus to defend Maldivian Government against a coup attempt. It was a highly successful attempt.
 
• **1996:** Maldives Institute of Technical Education (MITE) was established through Grants in aid from India.
 
• **2004:** After the disastrous effect of the Tsunami in 2004, India came forward to help the Maldives by being the first nation to send relief and aid.
 
• **2008:** a standby credit facility of $100 Million was extended to the Maldives during President Nasheed's visit to Delhi.
 
• **2014:** during the drinking water crisis in the Maldives, India launched 'Operation Neer' and supplied clean drinking water to Male.
 
• India has gifted two Advanced Light Helicopters (ALH) to Maldivian forces.
 
• **2020:** India supplied essential medicines and vaccines to the Maldives during Covid - 19 crisis under 'Operation Sanjeevani.'
